name: filters
description: One way to narrow a list, in two shapes. links: one choice among a few, each a link applied on press, with how many each holds and the one shown marked (All (5), Tasks (3)). form: several choices set together as labelled native selects, applied by one Apply button, then how many match and what is shown in words, with Reset. Both are plain GETs: the choices are in the address, so they work with no script and can be kept.

use.when: a list, a log, a set of results or a calendar a person wants to see less of: one kind of result, only what is not done, what the assistant changed this week.
use.not: moving between sibling pages, which is tabs; moving through a long list, which is pagination; asking for words to find, which is search.
use.with: the list it narrows, just under it; the server deciding which choices make sense and applying them, never widening what the list was set up to show.

shape.description: links for one choice among a few (about seven or fewer), applied as soon as it is pressed; form for several choices at once, applied by Apply.

label.description: Names the choices: the navigation's name for links (Kinds of result), the legend for a form (Show).

hideLabel.description: Form only: the legend is for screen readers only, where a heading just above already says what the list is.

context.description: Form only: the list's name, added unseen to Apply and Reset, so two lists on a page each have their own: Apply to Tasks with a day.

action.description: Form only: the page the form comes back to, with #the-list to land on it.

keep.description: Form only: the page's other address fields, sent on unchanged as hidden inputs, so narrowing one list keeps the rest of the page as it was.

choices.description: What can be chosen. links takes one; form takes one per select.

name.description: Form: the address field it sets, such as c-a1-done or who.

id.description: Form: the select's id, unique on the page.

label.description: What is being chosen, in sight: Sort, Done, Who.

value.description: Form: what goes in the address; empty for Any or All.

label.description: What a person reads: Not done, Tasks.

count.description: Links: how many it holds, said after it in brackets. Left out, nothing is said.

href.description: Links: the same page with this choice in its address.

count.description: Form: how many match, in words: 12 tasks.

showing.description: Form: the choices made, in words, when any differ from how it was set up: not done, due soonest first.

reset.description: Form: the same page without these choices, when any are made.

save.description: Form: Keep these choices, a POST that makes the choices shown the list's own setup, for those who may change it. Given only with reset.

fields.description: The choices and the page to come back to, sent as hidden inputs.

a11y.role: links: navigation holding a list of links, the one shown aria-current=page. form: a group (fieldset with a legend) of labelled native selects and an Apply button, then a paragraph saying how many match and what is shown, with a Reset link

keyboard.does: reaches each link in turn; in a form, each select, then Apply, then Reset, then Keep these choices where offered
on a link, shows that choice; on Apply, shows what the selects say
in a select, moves between its options without changing the page

wcag.notes: Links go to the same list narrowed, which is what a link is for, so pressing one is an expected change (3.2.2 is about changing a setting, not following a link); the one shown is marked with aria-current and in weight and a bar, not colour alone (1.4.1), and each is a 44px target (2.5.5). A form changes nothing until Apply, so moving through a select's options never moves the page under a keyboard or a screen reader (3.2.2, H32). Every select has its label in sight (3.3.2) and the group its legend (1.3.1). After either, the page comes back at the list and says how many match and what is shown, in words, with Reset beside it (3.3.1). Plain GETs: no script is needed, and the address keeps the choices.

machine.identify: data-shape says links or form. links: each a is one choice, [aria-current=page] the one shown, the count in brackets. form: each select is one choice, named as its address field; .sw-filters__showing says how many match and what is shown; its link is Reset. .sw-filters__keep is Keep these choices, when offered.
machine.operate: links: follow one. form: set the selects and submit, or GET the form's action with the selects' names and values added to the hidden fields' own; Reset is the same page without them. Keep these choices POSTs them to its action, which makes them the list's own where and order, undoable from the activity log.

props.label: Show and sort: Tasks with a day
